blocks.note: `tb`, the millisecond base the token bucket refills against (1000) — the sibling `nb` (64) belongs to the engine and is not copied
the packed-colour half word: `Lr` (halfBits 16, halfMask 65535, defaultMismatch 4096) and `dc`, which takes the high half — with `mc`, the low half
`Gn`, the channel layout one colour is packed with: 4 bits per channel, max 15, step 17, green at shift 4 and red at shift 8
`ys`, the sentinel (32768, the high bit) that marks a channel as the surface default rather than a packed colour
`mc`, the low half of the packed pair — the foreground half `$f` writes
`gn`, the word layout of one painted cell: width 8, then foreground default/red/green/blue at 0..3 and background default/red/green/blue at 4..7

the admission bucket: `bc` its capacity (4096), `fb` the fresh row (`{tokens: bc, refilledAt: 0}`), and `mb` the memoized accessor that lazily writes the row into the host registry and clears it again

the refill and the encoder: `yb` the tokens per second (160), `Sb` which refills the row against the clock and spends one token per admitted frame, and `$f` which writes one cell — the default flag plus the three channels of the foreground and of the background — into the surface word table. The sibling constants `gb` (1024) and `hb` (131072) are the engine's costs, not this pair's
`bb` and `wb`, the default raster size (512 by 256) the validating mount checks against
the validating mount: `tF`, which checks a key and size against the defaults through `Kbr`, and `Xto`, the field list a site mount admits
`Kbr`, the whole-number check both sizes answer: a columns outside 1..the limit gets `columns must be a whole number from 1 to N`, and a rows gets the same sentence for `rows`
